title: Parity-equivariant prediction of conformer-resolved electronic circular dichroism spectra accelerates absolute configuration assignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.21892v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Electronic circular dichroism (ECD) is a key experimental probe for assigning the absolute configuration of chiral molecules, but interpreting measured spectra often requires costly time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT) calculations. The few existing machine learning methods for ECD prediction are faster, but their accuracy still falls well short of that required for experimental applications. Here we introduce PhysECD, a parity-aware E(3)-equivariant framework that builds the spectrum from its underlying quantum-chemical quantities, ensuring correct chiroptical symmetry by construction. To improve generalization and support experimental applications, we construct SCECD, a conformer-resolved dataset of 578,104 computed spectra spanning diverse natural products with one to five stereocentres. PhysECD predicts ECD spectra from conformer geometries in milliseconds, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy on the CMCDS benchm

translated_title: 具有宇称等变性的构象分辨电子圆二色谱预测方法加速手性分子绝对构型的确定
translated_abstract: 电子圆二色谱（ECD）是确定手性分子绝对构型的关键实验探针，但解读实验测得的光谱通常需要耗时且昂贵的时间依赖密度泛函理论（TDDFT）计算。现有的少数用于ECD预测的机器学习方法虽然速度更快，但其精度仍远未达到实验应用所需的水平。在此，我们提出PhysECD，这是一个具有宇称感知能力的E(3)-等变框架，它从光谱背后的底层量子化学量出发构建光谱，从构造上确保了正确的手性光学对称性。为了提升泛化能力并支持实验应用，我们构建了SCECD，这是一个构象分辨的数据集，包含578,104个计算光谱，涵盖了具有一至五个手性中心的多种天然产物。PhysECD能够在毫秒内从构象几何结构预测ECD光谱，并在CMCDS基准测试上取得了最先进的精度。
tldr: 提出宇称等变的PhysECD框架，结合包含578,104个构象分辨光谱的SCECD数据集，实现毫秒级高精度ECD光谱预测，从而加速手性分子绝对构型的确定。
en_tdlr: PhysECD, a parity-aware E(3)-equivariant framework combined with the 578,104-spectrum conformer-resolved SCECD dataset, achieves millisecond-scale high-accuracy ECD spectrum prediction, accelerating absolute configuration assignment of chiral molecules.
